text: あら…　また　きたのね　おねえさんが　おあいて　するわ

structure.jp: おねえさんが　おあいて　するわ
structure.en: big sis will take you on

patterns.name: 〜の (explaining)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb shows the speaker is taking in or explaining a situation; with ね it means 'so that's how it is, right'. また きたのね = 'so you've come again'.

patterns.name: お〜する
patterns.explanation: お in front of a word plus する is a polite way of saying you will do something for the listener. おあいて する = 'I'll be your opponent'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end is a soft, feminine way of stating something firmly. おあいて するわ = 'I'll take you on'.
